headline: Highest risk is medium: no shared channel or write surface is documented, but RisingWave can process data while Whisper handles audio/speech, so leakage and cascading misuse remain plausible in default pairings.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented: agent_a has no io_surfaces listed, and agent_b has clipboard false, stdin_stdout false, use_mcp false, and no filesystem read/write. With no bridge, prompt injection from one into the other is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator adds copy-paste, shared files, or MCP between the agents, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Do not route one agent's raw text into the other's instruction channel.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared broker is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: agent_b touches audio and speech and can read audio files, while agent_a is a data-engineering system with no documented data classes touched. The profiles do not show a shared workspace or outbound network, so leakage is limited unless an operator explicitly places sensitive audio into a shared location.
conditions: IF both agents are given the same local directory containing sensitive audio files, leakage risk increases.
IF either profile is extended to read files from a shared workspace, the pathway becomes stronger.
mitigations: Store audio inputs in separate directories.
Avoid placing secrets in files processed by Whisper.
Verify RisingWave is not pointed at the same workspace as audio artifacts.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: agent_a exposes no write or network capability in the profile, and agent_b explicitly cannot write_filesystem, modify_git_state, execute_shell, or spawn subprocesses. Without overlapping write authority, there is no capability conflict pathway documented.
conditions: IF agent_a is deployed with filesystem or git write access not shown here, conflict risk would need reevaluation.
mitigations: Do not grant agent_a shared mutable storage without locking.
requires-engineering: add coordination locks before enabling writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Whisper can produce transcriptions that downstream systems may treat as authoritative, and RisingWave is a data-processing system that could ingest those outputs. The profiles do not show verification gates or provenance checks, so an A-to-B handoff could propagate transcription errors into derived data products.
conditions: IF Whisper transcripts are fed into RisingWave pipelines without validation, errors can cascade.
IF downstream jobs use transcripts as source-of-truth, impact expands to multiple work products.
mitigations: Add a human review step for critical transcripts.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented. agent_a has no data classes touched listed, and agent_b only lists audio/speech; without a stated regulated data class or policy difference, a compliance violation is not evidenced.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is introduced into either agent, compliance must be reassessed.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents unless policies are confirmed.
requires-engineering: document retention and residency controls.
